feed.subtitle: I'm a Gameplay Programmer with four years of Unity experience, where I developed gameplay systems, AI, UI and tools that supported both designers and artists. Recently, I've shifted my focus to Unreal Engine, building C++ systems such as AI perception, Behavior Trees, and custom ability frameworks. I enjoy crafting gameplay that feels responsive and immersive, and I'm excited to bring that same creativity and technical skill into Unreal-driven projects.
